Был взят большой холст, и на нём стала компоноваться картина «Гопак – пляска запорожцев». Удаль, веселье. profile.name: Sirmpa
profile.tagline: Folkloric dance tunes of Leros, Greece
profile.insight: On the Greek island of Leros, traditional musicians play folkloric dance tunes known as Sirmpa.
profile.profile: Sirmpa refers to traditional folkloric dance tunes from the island of Leros, Greece. These dance melodies share structural and stylistic similarities with Ukrainian hopak dance music. Specific details regarding choreographic tradition and performance history are not fully detailed in available documentation.
profile.profile_long:
Origins and History
Sirmpa refers to traditional folkloric dance tunes documented on the island of Leros in Greece. The music is recognized in comparative ethnomusicological notes for its relationship to dance melodies of Eastern Europe, specifically Ukraine.

How It Is Danced
technique not described in sources

Music and Instruments
Sirmpa consists of folkloric dance tunes found in Leros, Greece, which share melodic and structural characteristics with Ukrainian hopak music.
